courses.summary: YASREF 是延布的煉油設施；本課以原料品質變化、產品收率與海運出貨節奏建立教學情境。本課依序分析原料成分質量混合、產品收率與量綱、品質變動下氫需求、海運批次庫存、交接計量與時間窗，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: YASREF is a Yanbu refinery; scenarios examine feed-quality variation, product yields and marine export cadence. The course analyses mass blending of feed constituents, product yield and dimensional basis, hydrogen demand with quality variation, inventory for marine batches, custody metering and time windows, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
